draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets: r1 81.6>80.9, r2 88.3>87.1, r3 92.3<92.8, r4 76.4>75.6, r5 84.9>84.1, r6 90.2>89.0. On r3 (Ivel-Fraud) Ferrule is lower (92.3 vs 92.8), so "all six" is false.
